verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing page documents a ZeroTrace Mode that, when enabled, stops the service from storing search parameters, files, or data, so users have a product-level way to opt out of search logging. That is closer to data-retention control than a general telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, and the evidence is a single marketing line. Missing for 10: any client/SDK or MCP telemetry opt-out, how ZeroTrace is enabled and which plans include it, whether account-level usage metering or analytics tracking can be disabled, and independent corroboration.
